settings.heading: Density isn't firmness. It's how much foam is actually in the foam.
settings.body: Density measures how much material is packed into every cubic metre. A low-density foam can feel firm on day one and still collapse by month six, because feel and structure are not the same thing. A 50kg/m³ core keeps its shape under a dog's weight put on it in the same place, night after night, which is why we can guarantee the foam for five years.

settings.heading: What owners ask about the foam.

settings.question: What does 50kg/m³ actually mean?
settings.answer: It's the density of the foam – how much material is packed into every cubic metre. Density isn't the same as firmness: a low-density foam can feel firm on day one and still collapse by month six. High-density foam keeps its structure under repeated weight, which is why a 50kg/m³ core is still supporting your dog's hips and elbows years later. It's also why we can put a 5-year guarantee on it.

settings.question: What does CertiPUR-US certified mean?
settings.answer: CertiPUR-US is an independent certification programme for flexible polyurethane foam. Foam that carries it has been tested by an accredited laboratory for content, emissions and durability. It is the same standard used across human mattresses, and it is the reason we can tell you what is inside the bed rather than asking you to take our word for it.

settings.question: Will it help a dog with arthritis or hip problems?
settings.answer: Our beds are vet-informed and built to distribute weight so that pressure isn't concentrated on hips, elbows and shoulders – which is what makes lying down and getting back up harder for dogs with joint wear. A bed isn't a treatment, and it won't replace veterinary care, so please keep talking to your vet. What it can do is change the surface they spend fourteen hours a day on. Owners of older dogs are the ones who write to us most.

settings.question: What is the waterproof liner for?
settings.answer: It sits between the cover and the foam. Wet coats, muddy paws and accidents stop at the liner rather than soaking into the core, which is what turns a bed sour long before the foam gives out. The cover zips off over the top of it and machine-washes at 30°C.

settings.heading: You can only buy the core once.
settings.lede: Everything else on a bed can be washed, replaced or lived with. The foam is the part you are actually choosing.
